newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down 14 cents to 14.37 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down 14 cents to 14.37 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell 14 cents to 14.37 ringgit ($5.79) a kg to correct the sharp rise of the domestic market this week, traders said.
"There were lots of offers initially and buying only came in at the lower level despite the LME (London Metal Exchange) closing higher (overnight)," traders said.
Traders said offers to sell outnumbered bids to buy by 112 tonnes to 59. Buyers were Europeans and locals. Final turnover was at 96 tonnes, against 95 on Thursday.
The local premium against London narrowed to $90 from $170.
